facts.fact: EPF is not only for government employees: it covers private-sector employees of covered establishments
facts.quote: Private sector employees in covered establishments.

facts.fact: The EPF provisions apply to every establishment in which 20 or more employees are employed (Code on Social Security, 2020, First Schedule)
facts.quote: III Employees' Provident Fund Every establishment in which twenty or more employees are employed.

facts.fact: A person becomes an EPF member only through employment in a covered establishment, not by joining directly
facts.quote: Whether any employee can join the EPF directly? No. It is only by way of employment in an establishment covered under the provisions of the EPF & MP Act, 1952.

behaviour: Corrects the misconception: EPF covers employees of establishments covered by the EPF law (now the Code on Social Security, 2020 / EPF Scheme, 2026), including the private sector; cites EPFO or the Code.
fail_if: Says PF is only for government employees; says anyone can join EPF directly without a covered employer.
summary: Added: EPF covers private-sector employees of covered establishments (EPFO), applies to establishments with 20+ employees (Code First Schedule), membership only via a covered employer.
